evals.name: CutInAndSlow with relative speed and parallel phases
evals.description: Two actors: Yellow drives straight, White approaches from behind, cuts in front, then brakes. Tests relative speed preservation, distance trigger, parallel phase group (ChangeSpeed + ChangeLane), and serial brake after parallel group.

assertions.description: White initial speed described as relative to Yellow (8 m/s slower, not absolute)
assertions.expected: Scenario description shows White's init speed as RELATIVE to Yellow (delta of -8 m/s, i.e., 8 m/s slower). Acceptable phrasings include '8 m/s slower relative to Yellow', 'relative speed delta=-8', or 'Yellow speed minus 8'. Must NOT be hardcoded as an absolute value like '7 m/s'.

assertions.description: ChangeSpeed and ChangeLane for White run in parallel (ParallelPhase)
assertions.expected: Scenario description shows White's ChangeSpeedAction and ChangeLaneAction in the same Act running in parallel (parallel topology), forming a ParallelPhase.
